PNJ Bespoke

Representative photography of kitchens, bedrooms and staircases.

01 / The project

What it is

PNJ Bespoke presents made-to-measure joinery for three defining parts of the home: staircases, kitchens and fitted bedrooms. The website introduces the services, explains the business's approach and gives homeowners a route to start a project.

It is designed around homeowners considering a renovation or a bespoke interior. They need to understand both the visual possibilities and how the work can respond to the dimensions, storage needs and character of their home.

02 / The challenge

What it needs to solve

Bespoke joinery is not a standard product chosen from a shelf. The website needs to communicate craftsmanship and design possibilities while making the service understandable to someone who may never have commissioned bespoke work before.

03 / Design thinking

The approach

The structure gives staircases a prominent place, with kitchens and fitted bedrooms as clear companion services. Each area has its own explanation, so visitors can follow the space they want to improve rather than work through an undifferentiated list of services.

Imagery and concise copy work together to explain proportion, materials and practical use. The process content then connects the inspiration to a project journey, from discussing the home through design, making and installation.

04 / The experience

How it works

  1. Choose the space

    Explore the staircase, kitchen or fitted-bedroom service that matches the project.

  2. Explore the approach

    Read how the joinery is considered around the home, everyday routines, materials and available space.

  3. Start a conversation

    Use the project enquiry route to explain the property, location and changes the homeowner has in mind.

The aim is to turn visual interest into a useful project conversation, helping homeowners describe their needs and understand what a bespoke service involves.
